crossRefs.note: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.

Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land…
For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.
All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

Samaria will bear her guilt; for she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword. Their infants will be…
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your…
The high places of Isaac will be desolate, the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise against the…
I will cut off the cities of your land, and will tear down all your strongholds.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.
translations.bsb: In that day their strong cities will be like forsaken thickets and summits, abandoned to the Israelites and to utter desolation.
translations.kjv: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
translations.asv: In that day shall their strong cities be as the forsaken places in the wood and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it shall be a desolation.
